name: Oligodendrocyte
short_description: CNS glial cell with a small, dense-nucleus cell body and several non-branching processes, each ending in a flattened membrane sheet that spirals into compact myelin around a segment (internode) of a nearby axon; one oligodendrocyte myelinates several axons at once. Partly fuels the axons it wraps via a lactate shuttle; its myelin is the target in multiple sclerosis.
